verdict.rationale: Fireworks emphasizes open, standard formats (OpenAI-compatible API, same SFT data format) and lets users upload/download their own models from Hugging Face or cloud storage, which supports portability and reduces lock-in. However, there is no explicit documentation of a full data-export mechanism (e.g., exporting fine-tuning datasets, logs, or usage history) or an account-deletion/data-portability policy. Missing for 10: explicit data export tooling, documented account/data deletion process, independent confirmation of open-format guarantees beyond API compatibility.
